headline: First reading of Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan, teacher nominations, and revised policies on defibrillators and compensation guide.
summary: The committee will review a first reading of the Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan and consider financial, personnel, and donation items. It will also hold second readings of revised policies on Automated External Defibrillators and the Supplemental Compensation Guide.
items: First Reading of the Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan
Teacher Nomination(s) for New Teachers for 2026-2027 School Year
Second Reading of Revised Policy EBCF - Automated External Defibrillators
Second Reading of Revised Policy GDB-9 - Supplemental Compensation Guide
Representatives' Reports on Dropout Prevention, United Technology Center, Scholarship, and Other
Questions and Comments from the Committee
Information Items including upcoming meeting dates
